question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select No substitution required.

__**Neither of the**__ two brothers has been selected.
solution:
The correct answer is **'No substitution required'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• When Talking about two persons or things and one person or thing is excluded from the other, we use '**neither of, either of**'.
 
• **Examples,**
 
 
• **Neither of** my **two** best friends was present at the party.
 
• **Either of** his **two** sons will be selected for the position.
 
 
 
• According to the rule and examples that are given above, the given sentence is **grammatically** **correct **and does not need any improvement.

**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• '**Neither of, either of**' are followed by a **singular** verb.

 
 
• **E.g.** Neither of the restaurants we went to **was** good.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cc014001a9a70d86735241cc35c82dd42b72fdf15c186a2bedcc9dce43fb549.png] 

 
• जब दो **persons **या **things **के बारे में बात की जाती है और एक **person** या **thing** को दूसरे से **exclude **किया जाता है, तो हम **'neither of, either of'** का उपयोग करते हैं।
 
• **Examples,**
 
 
• **Neither of **my **two **best friends was present at the party.
 
• **Either of **his **two** sons will be selected for the position.
